description: This script handles the dualboot data check process for U-Boot on a specific platform. It manages partition selection, extracts image data from tar files, calculates checksums, updates U-Boot environment variables, and performs flash upgrade operations for dualboot configurations.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_datachk
methods.description: Main function handling the dualboot upgrade process, including partition determination, extracting image info, computing checksums, updating U-Boot environment variables, and flashing the new images.
